summary: Verified bug fix for #storyUploadModal FOUC. Modal is now completely hidden during page load (hidden attribute + display:none + visibility:hidden + opacity:0) on both EARLY (domcontentloaded) and LATE (networkidle+2s) snapshots. 'Hikaye Ekle' opens modal (adds 'open' class, removes hidden attr). Close button (data-testid=story-upload-close) properly hides modal and restores hidden attribute after ~300ms. Story circles (7 items = 6 sellers + add button), avatar images, and auction card images all render correctly. Buyer role does NOT render the modal in DOM as expected. One minor issue: Escape key does not close the modal (only close button works).

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Escape key does not close the modal. After reopening modal and pressing Escape, state remained {hasHiddenAttr:false, display:'flex', classList:['story-upload-overlay','open']}. Close button (data-testid=story-upload-close) works fine.

action_items: Optional: Add/fix Escape key handler in public/assets/js/custom/story-upload.js so pressing Esc while modal is open triggers closeStoryUpload().
critical_code_review_comments: Fix implementation is clean: hidden HTML attribute + CSS [hidden]{display:none!important} + JS toggling both hidden attr and .open class is the correct pattern to eliminate FOUC.
story-upload assets are now pushed to head via @push('styles'/'scripts') which prevents late CSS application (root cause of the reported bug).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for story upload modal FOUC verified end-to-end. Modal DOM state was inspected at both DOMContentLoaded and networkidle+2s — modal remains fully hidden (hidden attr, display:none, visibility:hidden, opacity:0) in both. Only remaining minor issue: Escape-to-close does not work; close button (data-testid=story-upload-close) works. The 'Hikaye Ekle' trigger is a DIV with data-testid='story-add' and onclick='openStoryUpload()' — NOT a button element (relevant for future selectors). Modal heading uses a div, not h2/h3 (relevant if selecting by heading role). Buyer role correctly excludes modal from DOM.
